api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: The token to authenticate against the API service.

email.title: User email
email.description: The email of the user who generated the API token.

domain.title: Workspace domain
domain.description: Your Jira workspace domain. It should be like the URL you use to access your workspace, without the https:// part.

start_date.title: Initial sync date
start_date.description: Starting point for data extraction. Only records created or updated after this date will be synced.

project_keys.title: Project keys
project_keys.description: List of project keys to filter (if no value is provided all projects will be extracted). Only entities belonging to these projects will be synced.
